failure_summary.description: Calls omitted or misrepresented supported optional constraints, canonical values, parameter buckets, or value types.
Some calls used malformed parameter entries or duplicated keys in the required JSON objects.
Calls used an unavailable endpoint or omitted part of the exact listed tool name.
A compound request omitted explicitly named product lookups and a separately requested repeat retrieval.
A search query included extra wording beyond the requested subject.

patch.reasoning: The skill already covers schema mapping, exact tool names, output formatting, and checklist coverage, so repeating those instructions is not warranted. One missed call came from treating an explicitly requested second retrieval of similar items as a duplicate; clarify when an explicit request for more results requires another call.

edits.target: - Account for every requested deliverable in the calls. Use separate calls for distinct operations or targets unless an endpoint explicitly supports handling them together. Do not infer calls from incidental context or a name match, or add duplicate or alternative calls unless the user requests separate results.
edits.content: - Treat an explicitly repeated retrieval as a separate requested output when the user asks for another, additional, or more results—even if it uses the same endpoint, target, and arguments as an earlier request. Do not deduplicate it; distinguish an explicit second retrieval from merely narrating the same action again.
